newsitem.title: UK: Spinner inquiry thin in Europe for cotton.
newsitem.headline: Spinner inquiry thin in Europe for cotton.

text.p: Spinner enquiry throughout Europe stayed thin and selective, and mainly short-term, despite the firmer appearance of asking rates for most Upland descriptions after Wednesday's strong advance on New York futures.

A retail business in Central Asian and African Franc Zone medium/better qualities was nonetheless under discussion in Portugal, Italy and France, and competitively-priced shipment offers of US styles again commanded attention in Turkey.
Eastern European markets generally lacked feature although Central Asian types moved off slowly in Russian and Slovak republics. The Long Staple sector lacked feature.
